# AgentPress Material Kit: TypeScript: integrating with build tools.html

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/integrating-with-build-tools.html
Ecosystem: TypeScript
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for TS config/compiler/type error docs: integrating with build tools.html

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py provider-error-explainer --error "common implementation failure" --json
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
- No claims of maintainer adoption.
- Keep examples small, sanitized, and reproducible.
